title: Surface every WMBT obligation in the interlocking or declare a structural residual

facts.note: Source validation.subject_kind is 'interlocking'; only artifacts identified as interlockings are subjects (not every sequence diagram).
Source validation.phase is CONFIRM with confirm-blocking enforcement; the harness must supply the current phase. Applies to every interlocking validated at CONFIRM, changed or unchanged.

fires: CONFIRM validates an interlocking that the planner authored or edited in this task.
CONFIRM validates an existing, unchanged interlocking (the coverage check runs regardless of whether the interlocking changed).
doesNotFire: Any phase other than CONFIRM (a planner may check coverage early while drafting, but the rule's enforcement point is CONFIRM).
Artifacts whose subject kind is not interlocking, such as a standalone wagon or WMBT document or a sequence diagram that is not an interlocking.

given: A train interlocking is the subject of CONFIRM validation and projects WMBT obligations.
when: CONFIRM checks that the interlocking covers its WMBT obligations.
then: Every WMBT obligation must surface in the interlocking as a message, self-message, guard, fragment, or invariant, or as an explicit structural residual.
prefer: For each WMBT ref, either show it with one of the five surface kinds or list it as an explicit structural residual with a residual id that names the WMBT ref.
Use the notation the project's interlocking validator already recognises; copy the form of existing passing interlockings.
avoid: Leaving a WMBT ref with neither a surface nor an explicit structural residual (silent omission).
Adding vague catch-all diagram elements that satisfy coverage without expressing the obligation.
why: The interlocking is a projection that must cover its source WMBT obligations; an obligation that neither surfaces nor is declared residual is silently lost from the train's behavioural contract.
evidence: For each failure the report includes interlocking_id, wmbt_ref, surface_kind, residual_id and coverage_status.
verifier_detail: Validation family: coverage; template: projection_covers_source; variant: planner_train_interlocking_wmbt_surface_or_residual.
Phase CONFIRM; validation.enforcement: confirm-blocking (a failure blocks CONFIRM); subject_kind: interlocking.
Accepted surface kinds: message, self-message, guard, fragment, invariant; otherwise an explicit structural residual (residual_id) is required.
Failure evidence fields: interlocking_id, wmbt_ref, surface_kind, residual_id, coverage_status.
audit: source name: Interlocking WMBT surface or residual
term wmbt_surface: every WMBT obligation surfaces as a message/self-message/guard/fragment/invariant or an explicit structural residual
